trace.name: presence.live
trace.cypher: MATCH (d:Dev)-[:RAN]->(s:Session {status:'live'}) WHERE s.last_seen >= $since MATCH (d)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:TOUCHES]->(c:Component) WITH s, d, t, collect(DISTINCT c.name) AS components OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[o:OVERLAPS]-(s2:Session {status:'live'})<-[:RAN]-(d2:Dev)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t2:Team) RETURN s.id AS id, s.task AS task, s.agent AS agent, s.started_at AS started_at, s.last_seen AS last_seen, d.name AS dev, t.name AS team, components, collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s2 IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {session_id:s2.id, dev:{name:d2.name, team:t2.name}, task:s2.task, score:o.score} END) AS overlaps ORDER BY started_at DESC
